items.positive_en: A chest-up three-quarter portrait fills the frame with a teal-robed swordswoman turning her head back over her shoulder. Her dark eyes look just past the camera, lips softly closed, loose strands crossing one cheek beneath half-tied black hair. One hand holds a wooden umbrella shaft beside her face. A weathered vermilion oil-paper canopy stretches across the top, showing bamboo ribs and a few worn edges. Her white crossed collar separates warm skin from the deep teal robe. Behind her, snowy ground becomes a narrow soft blue-white field. Live-action Chinese wuxia cinematic still, warm reflected light beneath the umbrella, natural facial planes, tangible paper and cotton, restrained film grain and soft highlights.

He wears a faded gray-brown wrap robe with a dark blue inner collar. One hand rests on the hilt of a sheathed sword beside his hip; the other touches a ceramic tea bowl on the tabletop. Dark beams and a small warm lamp remain softly behind him. items.positive_en: A shoulder-up close-up shows a wandering swordswoman beneath a broad woven bamboo hat. Her face occupies the center-left, turned slightly toward screen-right, bright watchful eyes looking off frame and the faintest smile held at one corner of her closed lips. One hand raises a small pale ceramic tea bowl just below her mouth. Loose black hair falls against a slate-blue robe and white inner collar. The hat brim frames her forehead without hiding her eyes. A few dark timber shapes and one blurred amber lamp suggest a tea house behind her. Live-action Chinese wuxia cinematic still, warm reflected facial light, cool muted background, visible bamboo weave and natural skin, fine grain and gentle optical softness.

The woman at the right end wears charcoal black with a rust-red sash, her long hair tied high and her sword lowered beside her leg. Both gaze along the bridge toward the other, feet planted on separate dry planks. Bamboo rises behind, and thin mist stays below the deck above a blue-green stream. Warm sidelight catches their profiles and railings. Live-action Chinese wuxia cinematic still, tactile wood, weighted cotton and restrained grain.
